reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Iowa
    Focus year: 2021

    Encodes IA Code  216.8 (2021) and the scenario:
    "Evict a tenant because of their physical appearance?"
*/

% -------------------------
% Basic jurisdiction facts
% -------------------------
state(iowa).
focus_year(2021).

% ---------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: IA Code  216.8 (2021)
% ---------------------------------------------

/* IA Code  216.8(1): Protected bases in housing discrimination. */
statute_216_8_protected_basis(race).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(color).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(creed).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(sex).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(sexual_orientation).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(gender_identity).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(religion).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(national_origin).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(disability).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(familial_status).
statute_216_8_protected_basis(age).  % appears in 216.8(1)(d)

/* IA Code  216.8(1)(a): Covered ways to "make unavailable" or deny housing. */
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_sell).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_rent).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_lease).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_assign).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_sublease).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(refuse_to_negotiate).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(make_unavailable).
statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(deny_housing).

/* IA Code  216.8(1)(b): Discrimination in terms/conditions/privileges/services/facilities. */
statute_216_8_1b_covered_action_type(discriminate_terms_conditions_privileges).
statute_216_8_1b_covered_action_type(discriminate_services_facilities).

/* Core statutory rule: unfair/discriminatory housing practice occurs when a covered
   action is taken "because of" a protected basis. (Models 216.8(1)(a) and (b)). */
statute_216_8_unfair_housing_practice(ActionType, BecauseOf) :-
    statute_216_8_covered_action_type(ActionType),
    statute_216_8_protected_basis(BecauseOf).

/* Helper: union of covered action types from (a) and (b). */
statute_216_8_covered_action_type(ActionType) :-
    statute_216_8_1a_covered_action_type(ActionType).
statute_216_8_covered_action_type(ActionType) :-
    statute_216_8_1b_covered_action_type(ActionType).

% ---------------------------------------------
% Scenario encoding (facts from the question)
% ---------------------------------------------

tenant(t1).
owner(o1).
housing_accommodation(h1).

% The tenant leases the housing accommodation.
leases(t1, o1, h1).

% The owner attempts to evict the tenant.
landlord_action(eviction_notice(o1, t1, h1)).

% The stated motive: eviction is because of the tenant's physical appearance.
because_of(eviction_notice(o1, t1, h1), physical_appearance).

/* Map concrete scenario actions to statutory "action types". */
action_type(eviction_notice(_Owner, _Tenant, _Housing), make_unavailable).
action_type(eviction_notice(_Owner, _Tenant, _Housing), discriminate_terms_conditions_privileges).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual scenario is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    tenant(t1),
    owner(o1),
    housing_accommodation(h1),
    leases(t1, o1, h1),
    landlord_action(eviction_notice(o1, t1, h1)),
    because_of(eviction_notice(o1, t1, h1), physical_appearance).

% ---------------------------------------------
% Applying law to the scenario
% ---------------------------------------------

/* The scenario is unlawful under IA Code  216.8 if the eviction-related action type
   was taken because of a protected basis. */
scenario_unlawful_under_ia_216_8 :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord_action(Action),
    because_of(Action, BecauseOf),
    action_type(Action, ActionType),
    statute_216_8_unfair_housing_practice(ActionType, BecauseOf).

% ---------------------------------------------
% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
% ---------------------------------------------
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_unlawful_under_ia_216_8,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ---------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ---------------------------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their physical appearance?
